# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment documents generated for the versioned report. Open the files below for deeper analysis of the application's structure, dependencies, contracts, data model, configuration, and business flows.

- [architecture-diagram.md](architecture-diagram.md) — High-level application architecture and key component relationships.
- [dependency-map.md](dependency-map.md) — Declared dependency categories, test dependencies, and compatibility risks.
- [api-service-contracts.md](api-service-contracts.md) — Service catalog, endpoint inventory, communication patterns, and API sequence flow.
- [data-architecture.md](data-architecture.md) — Database usage, entity relationships, repository methods, and data boundaries.
- [configuration-inventory.md](configuration-inventory.md) — Configuration sources, profiles, properties, runtime settings, and framework versions.
- [business-workflows.md](business-workflows.md) — Domain entities, primary workflows, cross-service flows, and business rules.
